text:
sqlpipe moves Postgres data to S3 in three stages. The reader process reads Postgres rows and sends them in batches to the converter. The batch size controls the number of rows in each transfer.

The converter changes each batch into a Parquet row group. It sends each row group to the uploader after conversion. The uploader writes multipart objects in S3. If an upload error occurs, the uploader retries the upload. Retries reduce incomplete objects when a temporary network error occurs.
